listening.english: Emma and Leo take part in a Pre-A1 adventure review. Emma: This is my bag. Leo: This is your book. Emma: I've got a ball. Leo: Have you got a pencil? Emma: I like apples. Leo: It has got a tail. Emma: It is big. Leo: It's a red hat. Emma: What is it? Leo: Where is the book?
listening.spanish: Diálogo completo con contexto y continuidad.
listening.note: El audio reproduce el diálogo completo, incluidas las diez respuestas ocultas en la transcripción.
